meta.title: Dynamic Viscosity Converter — Convert Pascal·second and More
meta.description: Free dynamic viscosity converter for 5+ units including Pascal·second, Millipascal·second, Poise. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Pa·s, poise, centipoise. Convert between 5 dynamic viscosity units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for dynamic viscosity in this tool is **Pas**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most dynamic viscosity conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Pascal·second | Pa·s |
| Millipascal·second | mPa·s |

content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this dynamic viscosity converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Pascal·second (Pa·s), Millipascal·second (mPa·s), Poise (P), Centipoise (cP), lbf·s/ft² (lbf·s/ft²).
